title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core

claim.summary: Steward has analyst agents, a Portfolio Manager and a protected Risk Manager trade from typed reports and a code-assembled seven-layer memory, while evening code grading and a gated, replay-verified quarterly prompt-learning loop evolve the periphery around an invariant order-and-risk core.

modules.name: Code-assembled seven-layer memory with outcome grading
modules.scope_reason: Layers hold holdings context, recent technical ratings, regime narrative, a size-bucket calibration and risk verdicts, and grades are computed from fills and later prices, all defined around portfolio decisions.

PDF p.5; passage beginning "The labels the Evening Analyst"

modules.name: Typed, gated and replay-verified prompt evolution
modules.scope_reason: Typed prompt-learning proposals, an allow-listed append-only gate with tripwire, similarity and cap invariants, one-step revert and recorded-input replay carry no temporal semantics and would work unchanged for non-temporal agents.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "Edits are append-only into"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "A decision-replay harness passes"

modules.name: Invariant order-construction and blocking risk core
modules.scope_reason: Deterministic order arithmetic, ATR-based stops, position, sector and exposure caps and a daily-loss breaker are rules on trading orders and cannot transfer to another task family without redesign.
